mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.10% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.10%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 850 thousand units signal strong residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 850.0, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate above 0.10% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 235 signal aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 0.10 and CPIAUCSL > 235.0, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tight labor market in a late-cycle expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 5.0, S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.0 (2017=100) signals robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 100.0, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 430,000 million dollars signal strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 430000.0, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 850 thousand units and retail sales above 430,000 million dollars signal a robust consumer spending environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 850.0 and RSAFS > 430000.0, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 (2017=100) indicates a weak manufacturing sector in an early-cycle recovery, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95.0, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
